history.action: ⚙️ FIX PR #219 CI (C910) — Applied optsWithGlobals() to terminal.ts and validate.ts. Root cause: Commander.js assigns --json to parent when both parent and subcommand define it. Without explicit merge, subcommand sees undefined. Same fix already in status/dispatch/insights (ec92a8d). Pushed d64f4c0 to PR #219 branch, awaiting CI. R-013: 71/71 verified ✅. 489 consecutive (C421-910).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Previous fix commit (ec92a8d) documented the pattern clearly, making it easy to apply to remaining commands. Lesson: L540 — When fixing Commander.js option conflicts, check ALL commands that define the same option. The fix was incomplete because it only covered 4/7 commands.
